item.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI), Nagpur, is undertaking three initiatives to strengthen financial inclusion, improve banking awareness and promote safe digital transactions. Under the nationwide Financial Inclusion Saturation Campaign, being conducted by the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance, in coordination with RBI and participating banks from October 21 to December…
item.title: RBI Nagpur Steps Up Efforts to Strengthen Financial Inclusion and Banking Awareness
